messages:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout v2.14.0 -> prod (change window 02:00-04:00 UTC). Canary 5% EU-WEST. Shifting in 2m.

maria: Observability preflight: synthetic heartbeat 0.8Hz, p95 150ms, 5xx 0.12% — baseline OK.

kevin: I’ll watch p95 + errors during ramp. If 5xx > 0.8% for 3m we auto-rollback.

sophia: Noted, tracing hooks enabled. @oncall-team please watch traces under /generate.

ops-bot: Snapshot pushed -> p95:152ms, 5xx:0.32%, error_budget_remaining: 94%

deploy-bot: Canary traffic shifted to 5% in eu-west.

sophia: Alert: synthetic txn failures spiking +0.5% over baseline in eu-west (1m agg). Investigating.

maria: Can you grep recent traces? suspect DB connection queuing. Also silencing noisy infra alert for 10m to reduce noise.

kevin: Running quick diag: `kubectl logs -l app=inference -n prod --tail=200 | grep "connection pool"`

ops-bot: Autoscaler note: DB pool scaling triggered +2 replicas, ETA ~90s.

sophia: Confirmed traces show increased wait on db.acquire. Spike correlates with canary shift.

maria: Pause further ramp, pin canary to 5% and hold. If 5xx sustains >1.0% for 5m we rollback.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift paused. Canary pinned at 5% (route pinned -> stable cluster).

kevin: Temporarily routing canary away from eu-west backend group A -> run only on group B: `curl -X POST https://internal-routing/shift?to=groupB`

ops-bot: DB pool now at target capacity, error rate dropping. 5xx back to 0.4%.

sophia: Agree with hold. Adding note to release: "mitigation: DB pool backpressure fix, hold canary, monitor for 30m"

maria: If after 30m p95 and 5xx stable, proceed with staged ramp 10% -> 25%.

kevin: I’ll open release thread and add timeline + rollout decision log. If we need rollback, we’ll cut to v2.13.9 (stable).

tom: Quick question — do we need to notify customers? No user-facing errors seen so far.

maria: No customer notice for now. Ops to file internal incident if we rollback.

deploy-bot: Hold ended -> manual resume required. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

ops-bot: Manual resume scheduled after 30m hold, will announce in this thread.

kevin: Adding to release notes: "Hotfix delayed - DB scaling mitigation applied during canary. No user impact." I'll link the canary snapshots.

sophia: Will follow up with traces + flamegraphs in the post-rollout thread.

maria: Thanks everyone. Leaving the thread open for the 30m observation window. :white_check_mark:
